w: Swamishri arrived in Lisbon at 1.35 pm from Paris. At 8.10 pm Swamishri was welcomed at the Palacio De Belem (Presidential Palace) by President George Sampaiao. H.E. Sampaiao, also the president of the European Economic Community (EEC), was informed about Swamishri's socio-spiritual services to society, Akshardham monument and London mandir. The President was impressed by Swamishri's divine personality and his activities. He said, "I am very happy that you have come here. You have my hearty wishes in your efforts for peace and harmony." The President was then offered a photo momento of the London mandir, publications and prasad. The diplomatic adviser to the President, Mr. Carlos Pereira Marques, opined, " Swamiji is a delightful personality. He speaks few words yet his presence is very much felt." ( News report )
The evening program of folk dances, speeches and drama. `Eet Ane Imarat' by children and teenagers was praiseworthy and inspiring.

Bal-Kishore Day This evening a special presentation was made by balaks and kishores in the evening Satsang assembly. They presented a drama, "This Court is different" and a folk dance. Finally in his blessings Swamishri emphasized the need for a morally and god-centred life.

ph: Swamishri is engrossed in Thakorji's darshan

st.t: A Spiritual Travelogue of Pramukh Swami Maharaj - 16 to 27 June 2004
w: 18 June 2004 (V.S. 2060, Ashadh sud 1) Friday, L.A. The Mayor of the City of Hawaiian Gardens, Leonard Chaidaz, presented a proclamation and a memento to honor Swamishri.

19 June 2004 (V.S. 2060, Ashadh sud 2) Saturday, L.A. Shilanyas Mahotsav Swamishri performed the bhumi-pujan rituals for a shikharbaddh mandir at the Ontario Convention Center. Swamishri performed pujan of the main foundation stone and the nidhi-kumbh. Thereafter an assembly commenced in the Convention Center. Mayor Gary Larson of Chino Hills welcomed Swamishri, and in his address said, “To me what His Holiness brings and what he presents to each of us is a coordination of values and family that I hold dear in my family and know in our community we hold very sacred. I want to congratulate you and tell you that those things that His Holiness brings and his teachings to you are important in your life. I hope that you are able to understand and apply those teachings and I’m sure that each of you feels the same on being here on this special occasion. On behalf of the City of Chino Hills, I want to tell you that I am proud of my relationship and my association with each of you. And I am proud to be here today in welcoming His Holiness.” Mayor Larson presented Swamishri with a City of Chino Hills Certificate of Recognition for his international effort and promotion of universal peace and harmony. Councilman Bob Huff, Council Member of the Diamond Bar City Council, said, “It is a great pleasure to welcome all of you and His Divine Holiness Pramukh Swami Maharaj. Welcome to our county. Chino Hills is the down end of our county in what we call the west end. We certainly look forward to this temple bringing your culture to our county and letting people know what goes on with your religion, with your culture and I personally look forward to visiting your temple as soon as it is complete. I am here today just to let you know that you are very welcome in our county. We look forward to your temple and its going to bring great plus in our county. And I’d like to say that I have great respect for your religion, especially when it comes to family values and this temple will carry on that culture.” Mr. Bob Huff honored Swamishri with a certificate of recognition on behalf of the Diamond City Council. Pete McCue, Supervisor of Santa Clara County, praised Swamishri, “Professionally, I am here representing the people of Santa Clara County to say thank you to you. I wanted to be here for this celebration. I also look forward to coming to the mandir when it is built and seeking knowledge and meditation there. I have been involved with the community since you first established your mandir in Milpitas. And I have appreciated the clothing drives, the health fairs that you have done locally. You have responded to the disasters throughout the world. And I am very proud of the fact that you sent volunteers down to help during the twin towers tragedy.
A medico-spiritual conference was held in the mandir hall. About 100 doctors availed of speeches of senior sadhus and blessings of Swamishri.

Sanskruti In the evening a cultural program, Sanskruti, about the glory of India was performed by the local BAPS children and youth. Finally Swamishri talked about the work of Bhagwan Swaminarayan. Devotees and well-wishers appreciated in the assembly.

21 June 2004 (V.S. 2060, Ashadh sud 3) Monday, L.A. Karyarkar Din In the evening assembly, Swamishri was honored with a citation by the local leader of the Muslim Community, Mr Kadri. Then the Mayor of Gardena City, Terence Terauchi, honored Swamishri with a Certificate of Welcome and the Council Member of Norvek City, Mr Rick Ramirez, presented a Key to the City to Swamishri.

26 June 2004 (V.S. 2060, Ashadh sud 8) Saturday, L.A.; Kishore Day Kishore - Kishori Din In the evening Kishore Day assembly a newsdesk was set up – called BAPS News West. The channel reporter visited the BAPS Swaminarayan Mandir and posed a question about the need for a mandir. Vishvamurti Swami answered the question. Then the reporter asked Viveksagar Swami about Swamishri’s life and work. Then the newsdesk presented inspiring stories from the lives of devotees. Then the newsdesk showed the large fomrat trailor of Mystic India and details about the mandirs in Houston and Chicago. This was followed by an award giving ceremony. Youths dressed as distinguished people felicitated Swamishri with a Ph.D. for solving thousands of people’s problems, Pulitzer Prize for writing letters, Noble Peace Prize, The World Citizen Award for his worldwide travels for the spread of peace, morality and spirituality, the Purple Heart Award for his pure and pious heart. Then through the Newsdesk presentation, data on Swamishri’s effort in building mandirs was presented. Dr Swami presented the World President Award to Swamishri and then spoke about Swamishri’s greatness. The kishores then performed a traditional colorful dance on the lyric, “Sadgun na bhandar Pramukh Swami…” and finally presented an 84 ft. long garland to Swamishri. After the dignitaries addressed the assembly Swamishri blessed the audience.

27 June 2004 (V.S. 2060, Ashadh sud 9) Sunday, L.A.; Children’s Day Saanskrutik Virasat The evening Children’s Day special program was held at the Anaheim Convention Center. The LA Children’s forum presented ‘Sanskrutik Virasat’ which depicted the stories of Shravan, Dhruv and Nachiketa. Thereafter dignitaries honored Swamishri. Finally Swamishri said in his blessings, “Today nobody has any time, but they have time to go to parties. But one’s home is like a big party. Whatever wealth and name you may have achieved will be of no good if your children become corrupt, sinful and terrorists. So there is a need to be vigilant while raising children. You are vigilant in your business. So, too, you must be awakened in matters about raising your children. You should also listen to them with love and care…” The devotees and well-wishers appreciated the evening program.

At 8.25 pm the evening satsang assembly had concluded in the mandir. Swamishri was walking back to his room. On either side of his pathway devotees were standing for Swamishri’s darshan. On seeing a devotee Swamishri asked, “Piyush, are you well?” “Yes,” he replied. “Do you come to the mandir?” “Swami, I live 100 miles away.” “Let it be 100 miles away, but you can come to the mandir two to four times a month,” Swamishri emphasised. On seeing Swamishri’s insistence, Piyush tried to shunt the track of conversation, “Swami, I have pledged for some donations to the Atladra mandir. That donation…” Swamishri interrupted midway and said, “Listen to what I have to say! Do come to the mandir. And if the mandir is too far then you have a little mandir in your house. Come to this mandir once a month, but do the arti, puja, thal and home discourse at your home mandir every day. And be careful not to eat meat and fall into bad company. You must assemble all the family members and read satsang books, sing dhun and kirtans. By so doing your house will become a mandir.” For spiritual progress it is essential to engage ourselves in some spiritual endeavours on a daily basis. Otherwise, the material influences of society and our own base instincts dilute or annul our devotional feelings, faith and morals. Hence, Swamishri prescribes regular attendance to mandir, daily performance of devotional rituals and reading of scriptures.

ds.t: A prayer on Pramukh Varni Din
w: Today was the 60th Pramukh Varni Din (the anniversary of his appointment as president). Pramukh Swami Maharaj came to the mandir for darshan. Here, before the murti of Shastriji Maharaj, he began to pray, overcome with emotion. The sadhus asked, "What did you pray for?"

Swamishri said, "Just that all the sadhus become well educated and ready, become good sadhus, study well and spread the knowledge of Akshar Purushottam throughout the world. That the circumstances of all the devotees become good and everyone becomes learned. That there is peace in the country and peace in satsang. That all the sadhus become very well prepared."

Having said this, pointing towards Shastriji Maharaj, Swamishri said, "We are to do only what pleases him. We are to act so that he is pleased. Keep the thought that our life becomes like that. Keep the thought that our saintliness becomes firm. We should always keep our eyes on him."
During the meetings, a devotee was passing by after darshan. Looking at him, Pramukh Swami Maharaj held his hand and asked, "What is your name?"
"Kanubhai."
"Do you want to say something?"
He said, "Yes, my twenty seven year old son had become a CA (chartered accountant) and suddenly passed away." Having said this, he broke down in tears. Swamishri blessed him and consoled him.
By reading the feelings of visitors passing by quickly during the meetings, holding their hands and giving them time to be heard, Swamishri provides everyone with an ideal, loving shelter.

After the meal was over, Dr Shekhawat Saheb came to meet Pramukh Swami Maharaj. He is the husband of Pratibha Patil, the present President of India, and has been to Akshardham twice. Swamishri placed a garland on him and blessed him.

Dr Shekhawat said, "Akshardham is a divine land. People come running here. There is no culture anywhere like Indian culture. I have travelled to many countries, and the goodwill there is in our country is not seen anywhere. The deep feeling here, and the detachment that comes after a certain stage of life, are not there in other countries."

Swamishri said, "Here, avatars of God have taken birth: Ram, Krishna, and Bhagwan Swaminarayan also came here. They have given sanskars to this country, and the rishis and munis have given sanskars. Our guru was Yogiji Maharaj, and he always used to say, 'O God, do good to all.' Whether someone believes or not, we should still pray that his intellect becomes good. In India everyone has compassion. There is the feeling of helping others, it is a sanskar, and through this sanskar there is peace and also joy. In Indian culture there is tolerance, and the feeling that good should come to all."

Then, as he was leaving, he said, "Yesterday my daughter had a high fever. At first she was taking only Ayurvedic medicine. Because of that the fever was not coming down. Yesterday, when she had to be admitted to the military hospital, I said to her, 'Tomorrow I am going for Pramukh Swami's darshan. I will take his blessings.' And just as we said this, news came from the hospital at night that the fever had begun to come down."

Today was the 60th anniversary of his appointment as President (of BAPS). Pramukh Swami Maharaj came to the mandir for darshan. Here, before the murti of Shastriji Maharaj, he began to pray, overcome with emotion. The sants asked, "What did you pray for?"

Swamishri said, "Just that all the sants, after studying, become well prepared, become good sadhus, study well and spread the knowledge of Akshar-Purushottam throughout the world. That the circumstances of all the devotees become good and everyone becomes learned. That there is peace in the country and peace in the satsang. That all the sants become very well prepared."

Having said this, pointing to Shastriji Maharaj, Swamishri said, "We have to do only what pleases him. We have to act in a way that pleases him. Keep the thought of making our lives like that. Keep the thought of making our saintliness firm. We should always keep our eyes on him."
During the meetings, a devotee was passing by after darshan. Looking at him, Pramukh Swami Maharaj held on to his hand and asked, "What is your name?"
"Kanubhai."
"Do you want to say something?"
He said, "Yes, my twenty seven year old son had become a CA and suddenly passed away." Saying this, he broke down in tears. Swamishri blessed him and consoled him.
During the meetings, reading the feelings of visitors passing quickly by, holding their hands and giving them time to be heard, Swamishri provides everyone with an ideal, loving shelter.

After the meal, Dr Shekhawat sahib came to meet Pramukh Swami Maharaj. He is the husband of Pratibha Patil, the present President of India, and has been to Akshardham twice. Swamishri placed a garland on him and blessed him.

Dr Shekhawat said, "Akshardham is a divine land. People come running here. There is no culture anywhere like Indian culture. I have travelled to many countries, but the goodwill that exists in our country is not seen anywhere. The sensitivity here, and the detachment that comes after a certain stage of life, are not there in other countries."

Swamishri said, "Here the avatars of Bhagwan have taken birth: Ram, Krishna, and Bhagwan Swaminarayan too came here. They have given good values to this country, and the rishis and munis have given good values. Our guru was Yogiji Maharaj, and he always used to say, may Bhagwan do good to all. Whether someone accepts it or not, we should pray that his intellect becomes good. In India everyone has compassion; helping others is a feeling, a value, and from this value there is both peace and joy. In Indian culture there is tolerance, and the feeling that all should be well."

Then, as he was leaving, he said, "Yesterday my daughter had a high fever. At first she was given only Ayurvedic medicine. Because of that the fever was not coming down. Yesterday, when she had to be admitted to the military hospital, I told her, 'Tomorrow I am going for Pramukh Swami's darshan. I will receive his blessings.' And no sooner had we talked about it than news came from the hospital at night that the fever had begun to come down."
Today, while Mahant Swami Maharaj was walking on the treadmill, a reading from the book "Yogi Vani" began. Extracts from the commentary Swamishri gave while walking are presented below:
Yogi Vani: "One who wants moksha should give up his faults of nature."
Swamishri: "This talk is for one who wants moksha. Otherwise, carry on as you are."
Yogi Vani: "If one tolerates, the great sadhu is pleased from the soul."
Swamishri: "Nowhere in the scriptures is such a thing written, by which the great sadhu is pleased from the soul. Only Yogiji Maharaj has said it."
Yogi Vani: "If someone says something to you: 'Oh! How fortunate I am; where would I find someone to say this to me?'"
Swamishri: "Impossible, impossible, impossible. Such a thing is rare for us."
Yogi Vani: "When the great ones are speaking, listen, but do not interrupt with your own cleverness."
Swamishri: "He may not speak, but it happens in the mind. One feels, 'I must say it, I must say it.' But listen with a calm nature; then the work gets done."
Yogi Vani: "If you have thoughts of lust and anger, I will smash you to pieces."
Swamishri asked, "Whom?"
The sadhus said what Yogi Bapa had meant: "The mind."
Swamishri said sarcastically, "The other person."
Swamishri laid bare everyone's mentality.

ds.t: The aeroplane of agna and upasana
w: A satsang shibir has been arranged for tomorrow. In it, two things drawn by Mahant Swami Maharaj were to be presented.
The first was a picture presenting the central theme of the children's presentation, "Agna and Upasana" (commands and worship).

Swamishri drew a flying aeroplane and wrote "AGNA" (commands) under its left wing and "UPASANA" (worship) under its right wing. He signed it SKS. Along with it he noted the date and time: 16.6.17, 10.17 p.m.
For the second presentation, he was asked, "Which command should the devotees follow?"
Swamishri wrote: "Ghar sabha."
